```{=html}
<iframe class="slide-deck" src="../../live/short.html" title="Slides of the part-day format, Europeanisation and the economy"></iframe>
```

Open the slides [in their own tab](../../live/short.html){target="_blank"} for the full screen, the speaker view and the keyboard controls: `[` and `]` jump between the two halves, and `g` opens a jump bar that finds a slide by its title. The slides have no optional runs, so every slide is shown. R loads inside the slides when they are opened, as in the webR workspace, and the cells of Tasks 1, 3 and 4 run on them.
